# Mortal Shell 2 Wiki

> Mortal Shell 2 Wiki — complete guides for the 2026 soulslike: interactive map, all Shell locations and builds, boss strategies, weapons database, full walkthrough, and patch notes. Fan-made resource, updated as we play through the game.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/): Mortal Shell 2 Wiki homepage — game overview, key mechanics, and links to every section.
- [Interactive Map](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/map): Full interactive map with all Shell locations, Tarstones, Beacons, boss arenas, and hidden collectibles.
- [All Shells](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/shells): Every playable Shell with stats, abilities, and exact locations.
- [Mortal Shell 2 Bosses](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/bosses): All 8 bosses. Attack patterns, weak points, confirmed regions, and strategy cards for each encounter.
- [Best Builds](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds): Proxima, Tiel, Eredrim, Gragu, Genessa, Lazlo, and Smert builds. Shell picks, weapons, Tarstone combos, skill trees, and FAQ.
- [Mortal Shell 2 Weapons](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/weapons): All 7 weapons confirmed. Stats, damage scaling letters, special abilities, exact locations, and Shell pairings.
- [Mortal Shell 2 Walkthrough](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/walkthrough): Start and get OP early. First two quests, first Shell, Axe and Daggers, early Tar Stones, Nail Shot +3, and the 135k Gloom per hour farming loop.
- [Mortal Shell 2 Tips: 18 Beginner Tips for Combat &amp; Bosses](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/tips): 18 beginner tips across combat, Shells, weapons, exploration, bosses, and farming.
- [Patch Notes & Updates](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/updates): Latest updates, balance changes, bug fixes, and new content.

## Builds

- [Eredrim Frost Breaker Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds/eredrim): Ethereal Diapason plus Slaughter stacking, Great Martyr's Blade frost infusion, and 200% damage to frozen enemies.
- [Genessa Phantom Summoner Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds/genessa): Faithful Doubles phantom stacking with Black Needle, Duality Stray form, and full skill tree.
- [Gragu Brawler Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds/gragu): Staggering Blow carry with Revered Heart sustain, Veteran's Battle Axe plus burn, and all-in melee Tarstones.
- [Lazlo Heat Tank Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds/lazlo): Heat meter and Retribution shockwave, overheat spikes, burn stacks with Veteran's Battle Axe, and 30% damage reduction at full Heat.
- [Smert Time-Stop Chaos Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds/smert): Miracle time-stop with Chaos stacking and detonations, Devotion resolve refill for infinite chaining, Black Needle plus Phantom, and Welt Cap passive.
- [Proxima Starter Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds/proxima): Duality Stone plus Arbiter's Prize. 14-point and 21-point Shell Bonding trees. Blood Curse boss melting.
- [Tiel Starter Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds/tiel): Shadow Strike loop with Escalation, Death Mark, and Poison Burst. 14, 23, and 40-point versions.
- [Sariel Curse, Break Build](https://mortal-shell2.wiki/builds/sariel): two builds — Thornfall damage spam or Entitlement break explosion. The Iconoclast + Zealot Stone, full Tarstone loadout, and final tips
